rows.job_description:
Role-AI Engineer

Exp-6+

Location-Bengaluru, Chennai





Key Responsibilities:

Drive technical direction for agentic AI initiatives, influencing architecture patterns, autonomy boundaries, and system design.
Design, build, and operate production-grade agentic AI systems used across multiple products.
Own and evolve shared agentic AI capabilities, including:
Design and Develop Agent frameworks and orchestration layers
Planning, tool use, and memory strategies
Design Retrieval and grounding (RAG) pipelines
LLM infrastructure, inference, and model gateways
Evaluation, observability, and safety tooling for autonomous systems
Lead technical design reviews and help teams navigate tradeoffs involving autonomy, safety, reliability, scalability, and cost.
Partner across teams to deliver complex, cross-cutting agentic AI initiatives from concept to production.
Evaluate emerging models, techniques, and agentic patterns and translate them into practical, enterprise-ready improvements.

Technical Skills:

6+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems + strong experience with LLM systems, agentic workflows or advanced ML infrastructure, async processing, queues, and streaming systems
Advanced proficiency in Python, Hands-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face.
Practical knowledge of model orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI), Familiarity with vector databases
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure AI, Google Cloud Vertex AI) and containerization technologies
Proven ownership of complex, cross-cutting agentic systems spanning multiple teams or products.
Strong engineering fundamentals across backend systems, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.
Deep experience across the agentic AI stack, including planning, tool use, memory, and evaluation.
Fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development workflows.
Ability to influence technical direction and align teams without formal authority.
Problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to articulate complex AI concepts to non-technical business stakeholders

Job Description

We are seeking a skilled Generative AI Engineer to join our team at Mumbai, where you will harness model capabilities to implement cutting-edge algorithms and solutions across myriad industries.

You will serve as a pivotal link between Data Scientists, ML and Platform Engineers to unleash the potential of Generative AI technology by implementing business-centric solutions. You will help customers find the appropriate level of refinement among semantic search, RAG, agents, and ultimately fine-tuning to reach their value delivery threshold in the most cost-effective way.

Beyond crafting prompts, you will be responsible for designing and building robust and scalable products starting with benchmarks of candidate FMs through targeted requests, rapidly iterating prototypes, and validating product ideas. Your expertise in orchestrating the entire AI workflow will ensure the seamless integration of advanced models capabilities into applications, optimizing performance, security, compliance, scalability, and efficiency. You will competently navigate between prompts, chains, and agents while mastering the underlying infrastructure challenges.

We invest in your success through comprehensive training, combining internal programs with resources from our technology partners.

Join us if you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI technology and making a significant impact in enabling our customers to create GenAI-powered applications with confidence and a fast time to market.

Key Responsibilities

You are part of a cross-functional consulting team that drives the adoption of Generative AI in every imaginable sector, working step-by-step with customers to understand business requirements to design then build bespoke GenAI solutions.

Build applications powered by LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, etc.) using LangChain, LlamaIndex, and related GenAI frameworks.
Implement RAG pipelines with vector DBs (Pinecone, FAISS, pgvector, ChromaDB) for grounding LLM responses with internal knowledge
Develop multimodal AI solutions (text, audio, image) and build autonomous agents where relevant.
Drive MLOps excellence: CI/CD (ML pipelines), drift detection, canary releases, retraining schedules.
Design robust and reusable prompt templates using CoT, ReAct, Graph-of-Thought, and Agent flows.
Continuously improve model reliability, relevance, and UX by tuning prompt flows
Deploy GenAI models on AWS/GCP/Azure using services like SageMaker, Bedrock, Vertex AI
Ensure performance observability, security guardrails, and compliance (GDPR, Responsible AI)
Work with DevOps teams to integrate GenAI solutions into microservices and APIs (FastAPI/Flask)
Benchmark open-source and commercial LLMs for use-case fit and cost-performance tradeoffs
Evaluate fine-tuning strategies (PEFT, LoRA, RLHF) where applicable for proprietary use cases
Support solution architects and cross-functional teams in delivering PoCs and enterprise-grade rollouts
Document frameworks, best practices, risks, and learnings for future scaling Qualifications
Bachelor s/masters degree in computer science, AI, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in NLP/ML/AI with at least 3 year hands-on in GenAI.
Strong coding skills in Python with frameworks like PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, and LlamaIndex.
Proven experience with cloud-based AI services (AWS/GCP/Azure) and APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face).
Experience with vector databases: Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone, FAISS, Milvus, or Weaviate.
Familiarity with prompt engineering, transformer architectures, and embedding techniques.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both highly technical and also non-technical stakeholders.
Sharp problem-solving skills.
Ability to collaborate with diverse teams.

Job Summary

AI Engineer role: The pathfinder for the Engineering team. AI Engineers need to understand the challenges on the ground and find solutions to improve efficiency in delivering solutions for faster time to market. AI Engineer is proficient in leveraging AI tools in applying real-world use cases for better productivity.

Responsibilities
The role of an AI Engineer is the pathfinder for the Engineering team.
AI Engineers need to be able to understand the challenges on the ground and find solutions to improve efficiency in delivering solutions for faster time to market.
AI Engineer is proficient in leveraging available AI tools in applying real world use cases for better productivity.
You are able to evaluate business challenges, decompose complex problems into AI-enabled workflows, and select the most appropriate models, architectures, and techniques to achieve measurable outcomes.
Experience with context engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent-based systems, and AI orchestration frameworks is highly desirable.
You are expected to design reliable, scalable, and secure AI solutions that deliver accurate, relevant, and high-quality results while aligning with enterprise standards and governance requirements.
Apart from that, you should be able to work independently, prioritize and organize your tasks under time and workload pressure.
Working in a multinational environment, you can expect cross-region collaboration with teams around the globe, thus being advanced in spoken and written English will be certainly useful.
Requirements
As an AI Engineer, having Python experience, Prompt Engineering and Generative AI models, and AI use cases application are required.
Knowledge of AI workflow tools such as LangChain and Google ADK will be a huge plus to help our company improve our business and IT processes with better efficiency.
Ability to work in a multinational environment with cross-region collaboration and strong English communication skills.
Benefits
Hybrid work arrangements to balance in-office collaboration and home flexibility.
Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
Medical Insurance: Self + Spouse + 2 children.
An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent-in-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre existing disease.
In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced AI Transformation Developer Enablement Lead to drive enterprise-wide adoption of AI-native software engineering practices using GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitHub Copilot, Agentic AI, and GitHub Actions. The role will lead developer productivity transformation initiatives, implement AI-driven software development practices, and enable engineering teams through coaching, change management, and large-scale adoption programs. The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in DevOps transformation, developer enablement, AI-assisted software engineering, and enterprise-scale technology adoption.
Key Responsibilities
Lead enterprise adoption of GitHub Copilot, Agentic AI, and AI-native engineering practices to improve development productivity and software delivery outcomes.
Assess AI readiness and engineering maturity across development, QA, DevOps, and platform engineering teams, identifying capability gaps and defining transformation roadmaps.
Implement AI-driven software development lifecycle operating models leveraging GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitHub Copilot, and GitHub Actions.
Drive adoption of agent-assisted and AI-enabled engineering workflows across planning, requirements, development, testing, deployment, and operational activities.
Execute AI transformation initiatives through structured onboarding programs, champion networks, change management activities, and adoption acceleration strategies.
Design and enable AI-powered engineering workflows utilizing Agentic AI concepts and automation capabilities within the GitHub ecosystem.
Lead developer enablement initiatives through hands-on coaching, workshops, office hours, and knowledge-sharing programs.
Integrate AI-powered automation into CI/CD and platform engineering workflows using GitHub Actions to improve quality, velocity, and operational efficiency.
Define success metrics, adoption KPIs, ROI measures, and productivity benchmarks to demonstrate the business value of AI transformation initiatives.
Conduct discovery and readiness assessments focused on GitHub adoption, AI-assisted development practices, SDLC maturity, engineering workflows, testing approaches, deployment processes, and developer productivity improvements.
Collaborate with engineering leadership and stakeholders to drive sustainable AI adoption and organizational transformation.

GitHub Enterprise Cloud
GitHub Copilot
Agentic AI
GitHub Actions
Intermediate

Experience
12+ years of industry experience.

Job Summary
As a Lead AI Engineer, you will own the design, delivery, and evolution of AI enabled legal solutions that support contract and compliance driven workflows across the enterprise. This role focuses on building and orchestrating agent based AI systems that integrate with Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms and enterprise workflow tools to ensure AI is embedded into governed, auditable legal processes.
You will lead endtoend solution design from intake through execution and post signature intelligence while making informed buy vs. build decisions, providing delivery estimation, and implementing scalable, secure AI solution architecture. This role requires close partnership with Legal, Procurement, Compliance, and IT, to deliver AI solutions that accelerate legal operations while maintaining regulatory and risk controls.
Key Responsibilities
Lead design and implementation of endtoend Legal AI workflows, including intake, orchestration, execution, and post signature intelligence
Evaluate and execute buy vs. build decisions for Legal AI capabilities, including delivery estimation, integration complexity, and total cost of ownership
Design and build custom AI agents to support legal use cases such as contract analysis, clause extraction, summarization, risk identification, and compliance validation
Implement orchestrated, multiagent systems that integrate AI services with CLM platforms and enterprise workflows
Architect and maintain secure, scalable integrations between AI systems and legal platforms, ensuring CLM remains the authoritative system of record
Establish engineering best practices for prompt design, agent orchestration, evaluation, monitoring, and AI governance in legal contexts
Collaborate closely with Legal, Procurement, Compliance, and IT stakeholders to translate legal requirements into durable AI solutions
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers contributing to Legal AI initiatives
Required Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
610+ years of experience designing and delivering software or AI enabled systems in production environments
Strong experience building LLM powered applications, agentic workflows, and AI driven services
Proven ability to design endtoend enterprise workflows, including integrations with multiple business systems
Strong programming experience in Python and API based integration development
Experience leveraging AI assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code or similar) to accelerate agent development, integration, and iterative refinement
Demonstrated experience making architecture and delivery tradeoff decisions in complex enterprise environments
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical and nontechnical stakeholders
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) or legal workflow platforms
Familiarity with legal or enterprise platforms such as Agiloft, Eudia, ServiceNow App Engine, GEP CLM, or similar systems
Domain knowledge in any of the following areas:
Procurement contracting
Commercial and vendor contract lifecycle management
Marketing compliance
Legal or regulatory affairs
Experience implementing AI solutions that clearly separate intelligence layers, workflow orchestration, and systems of record
